chunks: He who does not believe in God and His Apostle (should know) We have prepared for unbelievers a blazing fire.
ai.seo_question: What is the fate of those who do not believe in God and His Apostle?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inseparable link between belief in Allah and acceptance of the Prophet’s authority, often interpreted as a reference to the Imamate following the Prophet. It serves as a theological warning that rejecting divine guidance leads to eternal punishment, reinforcing the necessity of adhering to the Ahl al-Bayt as the continuation of prophetic authority.
